Three divergences in `fgetcsv()` / `str_getcsv()`, all measured against php -n
8.5.6. The first two are SILENT — they change the bytes a correct program reads
back, with no diagnostic anywhere.

1. The escape byte was REMOVED before an enclosure. php never unescapes on read:
   all the escape character does is stop the next byte from closing the field,
   and BOTH bytes land in the value. `"a\"b"` reads back as `a\"b`, four bytes,
   exactly what `fputcsv()` wrote. elephc answered `a"b`.
